notes.ordering: sequence is authoritative within a search; observed_ms is adapter monotonic time and must not decrease
notes.raw_vs_derived: raw telemetry must not contain controller residuals, aggregate rankings, overlap metrics, or routing decisions; those are derived later
notes.completion: bestmove null means only that the search produced no move; terminality requires terminal.fact provenance
notes.native: native payloads are lossless engine-specific evidence and must keep an engine-prefixed schema name
notes.terminal_provenance: terminal.fact source must use an approved independent rules.* or tablebase.* namespace
notes.work_units: known v1 work semantics have canonical units; engine-native extensions remain namespace-tagged
notes.common_numeric_finiteness: all numeric values in common telemetry must be finite; only event-level native.data remains engine-defined and opaque to this invariant
